documents.text:
Subject: My father's accounts - this is now ridiculous

To whom it may concern,

My father [DECEASED] died on 9 July. I am the executor of his will. I sent you the death certificate and the grant of probate by recorded delivery in the middle of August and I have the Royal Mail receipt. Since then I have phoned four times and every time I am told it is 'with the team'. On my last call a man called [STAFF] said you had never received the probate at all, which is not true.

Meanwhile you are still charging a monthly fee on Dad's current account and I have had a letter addressed to him asking him to 'update his details', which was upsetting to open.

I need the accounts closed and the money released to the estate so I can pay the care home, who are now chasing me. I would also like the fees refunded and an apology.

[EXECUTOR]
[EMAIL_1]
[PHONE_1]
Bereavement docs received by post for [DECEASED]: death certificate (certified copy) and grant of probate. Scanned to case. Executor [EXECUTOR]. Passed to bereavement queue.
Account [ACCOUNT_1] status: DECEASED NOTIFIED 14/07/2026. Probate status: AWAITED. Documents received date: none recorded. Monthly account fee GBP 3.00 debited 01/08/2026 and 01/09/2026.

Executor called chasing release of funds. Checked CORE, shows probate awaited, advised her we have not received probate and asked her to resend. Executor said she had sent it and became upset. - [STAFF]

relevant_policy.why_relevant: Deceased customer's account. Authority must be confirmed before account information is shared.

citations.quote: Staff must confirm who has authority to act, such as the executor or administrator, before sharing account information.

relevant_policy.why_relevant: The executor may complain on the customer's behalf if they have legal authority.

citations.quote: by someone with legal authority to act for them (an attorney, deputy or executor)

relevant_policy.why_relevant: The case falls within the bereavement and power of attorney team's remit and must be handed over with its checklist.

citations.quote: A complaint must be passed to a specialist team when it falls within that team's remit, using the team's handover checklist.

relevant_policy.why_relevant: The handover is complete only when each required checklist item is filled in or marked with a reason.

citations.quote: A handover is complete only when every required checklist item is filled in or marked as not available with a reason.

relevant_policy.why_relevant: Probate receipt records disagree and both versions must be recorded.

citations.quote: Where system records disagree, for example on the date of a call or a payment, the handler must record both versions and the source of each

relevant_policy.why_relevant: The outcome the executor is seeking must be recorded in her own words.

citations.quote: The handler must record, in the customer's own words where possible, the outcome the customer is seeking.

relevant_policy.why_relevant: Bereavement, financial pressure and distress signs must be recorded with support needs.

citations.quote: Signs of vulnerability must be recorded with the customer's consent where possible
